name: Graphite One Inc.
summary: Graphite One Inc. operates as mineral exploration company in the United States. Its primary project is the Graphite Creek property that consists of 135 mining claims located on the Seward Peninsula, Alaska. Graphite One Inc. was formerly known as Graphite One Resources Inc. and changed its name to Graphite One Inc. in February 2019. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
